verdict.rationale: The Files API announcement explicitly covers the story: eight endpoints plus both the TypeScript and Python SDKs can browse, upload, download, and edit an agent's disk over HTTP, even while the agent sleeps. Persistent per-agent storage is also documented. missing for 10: dedicated SDK file-method reference docs (evidence is a single blog summary), explicit read/write method signatures or examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
